question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.**
solution:
The correct answer is:** easily**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Easily** means without difficulty or effort.

 
 
• **Example - ***Tom loses his temper so **easily** that everybody avoids him.*
 
 
 
• ​We use **'easily'** to **emphasize that something is very likely to happen, or is very likely to be true.**
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is 'easily'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *Dust storms do not just happen in the middle of the desert. They can happen in __any__ (1) dry area where loose dirt can **__easily__ (2)** be picked up. Don't be surprised (3)________ you suddenly saw a dust storm (4)_________ your way. Dust storms usually (5)________ without warning.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Slowly** means at a slow speed; not quickly.
 
• **Casually** means in a relaxed and informal way.
 
• **Properly** means correctly or satisfactorily.
